title: Shape
description: Primary work node in the Shapes Specification. Represents a unit of intent — a feature, component, task, or any decomposable piece of work.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for this shape.

description.description: Prose description of what this shape represents and why it exists.

profile.description: Reference to the governance profile that controls this shape's lifecycle and field requirements.

version.description: Semantic version string tracking the evolution of this shape.

predecessors.description: Shape IDs that this shape supersedes or evolves from.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of this shape (e.g. proposed, canonical, superseded).

intent.description: Structured declaration of what this shape is meant to achieve and why.

constraints.description: References to Constraint nodes that apply to this shape.

realization.description: Bindings that map this shape's intent to concrete artifacts (files, modules, endpoints, etc.).

evidence.description: Verification records proving that this shape's intent has been satisfied.

provenance.description: Origin and authorship records for this shape.

amendment_log.description: Ordered list of Amendment IDs that have modified this shape.

parents.description: References to parent shapes in the decomposition hierarchy.

children.description: Child shapes nested under this shape, forming a decomposition tree.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to this shape. Profile field declarations may constrain which keys are expected.

ShapeChildRef.title: ShapeChildRef
ShapeChildRef.description: Reference to a child shape, either by ID or as a fully inline shape definition.

shape.description: The child shape, specified as either a numeric ID reference or a full inline Shape.

role.description: The role this child plays within its parent (e.g. 'component', 'subtask', 'dependency').

reason.description: Explanation of why this child exists under this parent.

ShapeRef.title: ShapeRef
ShapeRef.description: Untagged union: either a numeric Shape ID for referencing an existing shape, or a full inline Shape definition.

oneOf.description: Numeric ID referencing an existing shape defined elsewhere.
Full inline Shape definition nested directly in the parent.
